value.rationale: Canonical consecutive missing lengths M12 and M14 link an actively studied family to geometric fixed-point topology of larger circular ladders. Exact, torsion-free integral sphere-wedge classifications for all matchings go beyond existing perfect-matching-generated classifications and rational traces. The quotient-model lemma is structural for all k; exhaustive, acyclic two-size computations provide a nontrivial motivated benchmark for subsequent periodicity questions. Not just an Euler characteristic or arbitrary parameter slice.
